articles.summary: Ambiq announces that Northern Mechatronics has chosen Apollo3 Blue SoC for its latest LoRa Bluetooth Low Energy 5 Module, NM180100. Learn more.
articles.title: Ambiq and Northern Mechatronics Delivers Pre-Certified Ultra-Low Power Edge Computing LoRa Bluetooth Low Energy Connectivity for Predictive and Preventive IoT in a Single Package Module Solution
